tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI is adding invisible AI watermarks to ChatGPT and Codex for EU users, complying with EU AI Act regulations. Confirmed by Gizmodo.
OpenAI apologizes for government website breaches; artists warn copyright law changes would harm Australia's creative sector. The Guardian reports this as Confirmed.
OpenAI is in $30B funding talks with MGX and BlackRock, valued at $1.4T, with IPO delayed to 2027. Reported by The Cryptonomist.
Google may expand Call for Me to send messages to friends and family via Gemini artificial intelligence. Still open, per The Verge.
NYC holds artificial intelligence risk hearing with whistleblowers and tech leaders, proposing human oversight and safeguards. Confirmed by News 12 Long Island.
Free every hour.
